services.name: Tandem Jumps
services.desc: At Skydive Space Center, Florida's Premier Skydiving Center, we do the World's Highest Tandem Jumps-18,000 Feet- Everyday of the week! Other centers may promise an 18,000 foot jump, but we are the only Center in Florida that actually does these jumps everyday! This 18,000 foot jump is our most popular option. We call it GO BIG OR GO HOME! If you want to the best experience with the longest freefall and best views, then this jump is for you. Skydive Space Center is the best place to make your first tandem jump in Florida. After a briefing on skydiving training and safety, you will completely understand the equipment and the sequence of events. You and your jumpmaster will board the aircraft
